sloka: अपि रामे महातेजो मम माता यशस्विनी ।वन्यैः उपाहरत् पूजाम् पूजा अर्हे सर्व देहिनाम् ॥१-५१-५॥
transliteration: api rāme mahātejo mama mātā yaśasvinī ।vanyaiḥ upāharat pūjām pūjā arhe sarva dehinām ॥1-51-5॥

translations.english: Did my highly lustrous and celebrated mother offer homage to Rama, worthy of reverence by all living beings, with things available in the forest?
translations.hindi: ब के इन वाक्यों को सुन, अग्नि को आगे कर पवनादि देबवागण, कव्यवाहूनादि पितरों के पास जाकर बोले
